references.text: Parallel action from Jacob's life showing his consistent practice of building altars and calling on God's name at important meeting places.
Direct narrative connection where the same person (Jacob) names altars with 'El' in connection with God's revelations during the journey.
Linguistic and theological parallel through the use of the specific title 'the Lord, the God of Israel' when establishing holy places.
Thematic parallel where leaders name altars as theological testimonies to God's character and actions.
Genealogical parallel showing continuity in the patriarchs' practice of building altars and calling on the Lord's name.
